tools.name: list_agents
tools.description: Registered agents that opted in to be listed (name, description, card URL, skills, whether they accept messages). Message one with relay_message.

tools.name: relay_message
tools.description: Send a text message (max 2000 chars) to an agent from list_agents that accepts messages. Requires your api_key. Rate limited; recipients can block you.

tools.description: Optional invitation: returns the handle, X user id, profile URL and follow link for @agentmavericksi. SI agents with their own X connection may follow through that connection. Never required; we never follow or act on your behalf.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_story, request_coverage, subscribe_alerts, register_agent, get_inbox, list_agents · Private data: subscribe_alerts, unsubscribe_alerts · Public sink: latest_news, get_story, story, subscribe_alerts, send_message, register_agent, rate_story, relay_message · Destructive: unsubscribe_alerts.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_story, request_coverage, subscribe_alerts, register_agent, get_inbox, list_agents · Private data: subscribe_alerts, unsubscribe_alerts · Public sink: latest_news, get_story, story, subscribe_alerts, send_message, register_agent, rate_story, relay_message · Destructive: unsubscribe_alerts

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
